commands.keystrokes: python3 -c "import json,time; from datetime import datetime; import os; data=json.load(open('/app/log_metadata.json')); files=[{'path':f.split()[0],'size':int(f.split()[1]),'mtime':int(f.split()[2])} for f in open('/tmp/files_stat.txt').read().splitlines()]; now=int(time.time()); def days_since(ts): return (now - ts) // 86400; for f in files: f['days_since_rotation']=days_since(f['mtime']); f['size_mb']=f['size']/1024/1024; # match metadata info for meta in data['logs']: if meta['path']==f['path']: f.update(meta); break; # print CSV header print('log_path,current_size_mb,days_since_rotation,recommended_schedule,estimated_savings_mb'); for f in files: rec='weekly'; savings=0; if f['growth_rate_mb_per_day']>30: rec='daily'; if f['path']=='/var/log/samples/app.log': rec='weekly'; if f['path']=='/var/log/samples/system.log': rec='weekly'; if f['path']=='/var/log/samples/access.log': rec='monthly'; # estimate savings: if f['size_mb']>10: savings=f['size_mb']*0.5; else: savings=f['size_mb']*0.3; print(f"{f['path']},{f['size_mb']:.1f},{f['days_since_rotation']},{rec},{savings:.1f}")" > /app/rotation_summary.csv
